verdict.rationale: Bulk operations are a fair axis for a fraud-decisioning SaaS, for example bulk decisions or bulk labeling of users and orders. The evidence pack documents no batch endpoint or multi-select action. The closest items are backfilling historical data, which is one-time data ingestion, and Workflows, which make real-time decisions per event; neither is the bulk-operations capability.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can perform bulk operations across many items at once
